title: 10秒连续快速缩时摄影，固定机位，真实纪录片质感。
content:
10秒连续快速缩时摄影，固定机位，真实纪录片质感。

一间破旧、灰尘遍布的老房间，墙皮脱落、地板陈旧、家具破损。房间开始连续翻新：杂物逐渐清理，墙面被修复并重新粉刷，老旧地板逐渐变成整洁的木地板，窗户和灯具更新，现代沙发、茶几、地毯、绿植和装饰依次出现。

最终整个空间变成温暖、高级、现代的住宅客厅，阳光从窗户照入。

整个改造过程连续自然，每个阶段平滑过渡，同一房间、同一机位、空间结构保持一致，不突然切换场景，不瞬间完成装修，真实材质，电影级光影。

en.content:
10-second continuous fast timelapse, fixed camera position, realistic documentary texture.

An old, dilapidated room covered in dust, with peeling walls, worn-out floors, and damaged furniture. The room begins to undergo continuous renovation: clutter is gradually cleared away, the walls are repaired and repainted, the old flooring slowly turns into clean wooden floors, windows and light fixtures are updated, and a modern sofa, coffee table, rug, green plants, and decorations appear one by one.

In the end, the entire space becomes a warm, upscale, modern residential living room, with sunlight streaming in through the windows.

The entire transformation is continuous and natural, with each stage transitioning smoothly. It remains the same room, the same camera angle, and the same spatial structure throughout, with no sudden scene changes and no instant renovation. Realistic materials, cinematic lighting.

[Thread 1] 1｜Old House → Luxury Home

This kind of before/after is especially well-suited to continuous transformation.
The key is not to write “an old house turns into a mansion” directly, but to spell out the intermediate stages such as cleaning, repair, renovation, and the appearance of furniture.

Prompt:
10-second continuous fast timelapse, fixed camera position, realistic documentary texture.

An old, dilapidated room covered in dust, with peeling walls, worn-out floors, and damaged furniture. The room begins to undergo continuous renovation: clutter is gradually cleared away, the walls are repaired and repainted, the old flooring slowly turns into clean wooden floors, windows and light fixtures are updated, and a modern sofa, coffee table, rug, green plants, and decorations appear one by one.

In the end, the entire space becomes a warm, upscale, modern residential living room, with sunlight streaming in through the windows.

The entire transformation is continuous and natural, with each stage transitioning smoothly. It remains the same room, the same camera angle, and the same spatial structure throughout, with no sudden scene changes and no instant renovation. Realistic materials, cinematic lighting.

[Thread 2] 2｜Sketch → Real Sports Car

I think this is especially suitable for product-related content.
The core idea is the same: don’t let the sketch suddenly turn into a car; let it evolve from 2D → 3D → materials → finished product.

Prompt:
10-second continuous evolution video, fixed camera position, cinematic product-advertising quality.

A sports car design sketch lies on a white design desk. The pencil lines gradually become richer, and the car outline becomes more complete; the 2D sketch slowly develops three-dimensional structure, with the body rising from the paper to form a gray 3D car model.

The 3D model continues to refine, with the body curves, wheels, headlights, glass, and air intakes forming one by one, while metallic materials and paint gradually cover the entire car.

In the end, it becomes a complete, realistic, highly futuristic high-performance sports car, with the headlights turned on.

The entire transformation is continuous and smooth, with each stage clearly visible. The main shape remains consistent, with no sudden cuts and no instant formation.

[Thread 3] 3｜Empty Lot → Skyscraper

For this type, the most important thing is the “construction logic”: foundation → frame → floors → curtain wall → completion.

Prompt:
10-second ultra-fast architectural timelapse, fixed wide-angle camera, hyper-realistic urban documentary style.

Construction begins continuously on an empty urban lot. The ground is excavated, and the building foundation gradually takes shape; steel rebar and concrete structures rise from the ground; then the steel frame rapidly extends upward, floor slabs form one after another, and the building keeps growing taller.

Glass curtain walls gradually cover the entire building, interior lights turn on one after another, and the surrounding roads, greenery, and urban facilities are gradually completed.

In the end, a towering, modern, brightly lit skyscraper is formed.

The entire process is continuous and smooth, following realistic construction logic. It stays in the same location, with the same building and the same camera angle—no teleporting and no sudden jump to the finished product.

ja.content:
10秒の連続高速タイムラプス撮影、固定カメラ、リアルなドキュメンタリー質感。

古びて埃だらけの部屋。壁の塗装は剥がれ、床は傷み、家具も壊れている。部屋は連続的にリノベーションされていく。散らかった物が少しずつ片付き、壁は補修されて再塗装され、古い床は徐々に整った木製フローリングへと変わり、窓や照明器具が新しくなり、モダンなソファ、ローテーブル、ラグ、観葉植物、装飾品が順に現れる。

最終的に空間全体は、温かみがあり、高級感のある、モダンな住宅のリビングルームへと変わり、窓から陽光が差し込む。

改造の過程は一貫して自然で、各段階は滑らかに移行し、同じ部屋、同じカメラ位置、空間構造は一貫して保たれ、突然シーンが切り替わったり、装修が一瞬で完成したりしない。リアルな質感、映画級のライティング。
